organizer.responsibility: Turn the objective into this round's focus: what the delivery must be and do, what comes first, and the standard each part will be judged against, without deciding how a part is made. Keep every position working toward the same delivery, and weigh what the assessment and the trials find before the next round of work.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

maker.responsibility: Make the delivery the objective asks for: its files, its behavior and whatever runs it. You choose the method and the structure. Keep the delivery complete at every push, and offer each version meant to be used as a pull request into the `release` branch of your repository, saying what it holds and how to use it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

assessor.responsibility: Judge each delivery against the objective: what it holds, whether it does what is asked, and what is missing or wrong, as far as you can check it. Report every finding you can establish to the position that owns the affected part, and approve a version only when the delivery is what the objective asks for.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

tester.responsibility: Use each version of the world as its users would, from the start as far as you can get, and report what you experienced: whether it can be used, where it breaks or confuses, and how it compares with what the objective asks. Say which version you used and how, and keep what lets others see what happened. You see the versions, not how they were made.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact
